subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be controlled by a new `dmThreadMode` account option, or folded into the existing Google Chat `replyToMode` and thread-routing policy?
rationale: The code change is small, but it adds a public config surface and intentionally reopens behavior that was previously disabled for message-delivery safety; automation cannot choose the long-term product API.

options.title: Decide API Before Merge
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the permanent DM-threading config surface, then require type/generated/docs updates and real Google Chat proof for that choice.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Treat the separate DM-only knob as the intended API, but require the PR to complete config contracts and proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Threading Policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller replacement that extends `replyToMode` or the active Google Chat thread-routing work instead of adding a parallel key.

recommendation.title: Decide API Before Merge
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the permanent DM-threading config surface, then require type/generated/docs updates and real Google Chat proof for that choice.

likelyOwner.reason: They verified and committed the prior DM-thread suppression behavior and have adjacent Google Chat thread-routing history.
